films.title: Flatfoot in Egypt
films.overview: Inspector Rizzo and Marshal Caputo go to Egypt and look for Professor Cerullo, who is missing.

films.title: The Knock Out Cop
films.overview: Inspector “Flatfoot” Rizzo investigates crime and corruption in Naples.

films.title: Flatfoot in Hong Kong
films.overview: Inspector Rizzo is accused of drug trafficking. In order to clear his name he has to find out who is the person, from a Mafia ring, who has infiltrated his police department.

films.title: Flatfoot in Africa
films.overview: Inspector Rizzo in Napoli gets a message from a policeman from South Africa who wants to meet him. Immediately before this meeting the South African policeman is killed. Dying he shows Rizzo a picture of his young son Bodo. Rizzo travels to Johannesburg to find out what the policeman was working on and to find Bodo.

films.title: Banana Joe
films.overview: Island farmer Banana Joe helps the local community by trading his bananas for goods. When gangsters arrive with plans to construct a banana processing plant, Joe kicks them out, but the mob boss discovers that Joe is operating without a license. After the mob tips off the authorities and Joe's boat is impounded, he ventures into a big city for the first time to seek help.

films.title: An American in Rome
films.overview: Nando Moriconi is a young Italian living in Rome obsessed with all-things American.

films.title: Totó in color
films.overview: In the first Italian film to be shot in color, Totò portrays a musician named Antonio Scannagatti who strongly hopes to sell his composition, "Epopea italiana", to Tiscordi, who is one of the most important Italian impresarios.

films.title: Cops and Robbers
films.overview: Esposito is a thief who cons tourists in Rome. Officer Bottoni manages to catch him and starts persecuting him. When Esposito manages to flee, Bottoni's superiors inform him that he'll lose his job if he can't catch Esposito.

films.title: Letto a tre piazze
films.overview: Antonio married Amalia and went to fight in Russia during World War II. Since he didn't return Amalia thought he was dead, so she married another man. Many year after the war end, Antonio returned. Amalia has to choose between two husbands.

films.title: Horse Fever
films.overview: Bruno Fioretti, known as "Mandrake", is an inveterate gambler who never misses a day at the horse racing track in Rome. He is doubly unlucky: he bets too much on one horse, and his wife is sleeping with his best friend because Mandrake is always at the track. Penniless and cuckolded, Mandrake decides to make one last bet.

films.title: Totò vs the Four
films.overview: The day of Chief Constable Saracino begins badly when his new car is stolen. Then, in his office, he meets Alfredo Fiori who believes that his wife and her lover, a veterinary, are trying to murder him.

films.title: Toto and the Women
films.overview: Antonio Scaparro (Toto) is obsessed for women. He invents his own way to hide from them - in the attic of his house.

films.title: Totò Looking for a House
films.overview: Beniamino and his family have lived inside a school since the end of the war. After five years they have to move, but in Rome it's not easy to find an apartment.

films.title: Toto and the Kings of Rome
films.overview: An aging, down-and-out public employee must face the primary school examination.

films.title: A Day in Court
films.overview: A day at an Italian trial court, where a magistrate judges a full array of peculiar petty crimes and characters.

films.title: The Overtaxed
films.overview: Mr. Pezzella owns and operates a well-established luxury-clothing store. He does not like and does not consider it right to pay taxes and therefore uses a tax consultant to be able to evade more taxes.

films.title: Magic Touch
films.overview: Andrea, a forty-year old engineer, suddenly becomes unemployed while his wife France gets a promotion. He is very down hearted and since he does not want to be a burden to his family he takes the place of the house maid.

films.title: Bonnie and Clyde Italian Style
films.overview: Two stupid lowlifes are "forced" into a life of violent crime on the streets of Italy. What follows is a mocking takeoff of the American crime classic "Bonnie and Clyde."

films.title: Totò diabolicus
films.overview: The marquis Galeazzo di Torre Alta is murdered by a mysterious killer who calls himself Diabolicus. His heirs are his three brothers and a sister, but all of them, with the exception of Monsignor Antonino di Torre Alta, are killed by Diabolicus. The police are unable to solve the case, but when Antonino gives his inheritance to Pasquale Bonocore, illegitimate son of his father and Pasquale is in prison and therefore can't be the killer, all the clues are in the hand of the police.

films.title: Hot Potato
films.overview: A factory worker known for his tough attitude and for fighting for workers' rights starts losing credibility when friends and co-workers see him helping a young gay man.

films.title: Two Colonels
films.overview: In WWII Greece, two enemy Colonels, one Italian and the other English, develop a grudging friendship which the war will test.
